source_caption:
🎬 Instant Family (2018)

Instant Family follows Pete and Ellie Wagner, a happily married couple whose lives take an unexpected turn when they decide to explore foster care and adoption. Initially believing they might welcome one young child into their home, they soon meet Lizzy, a strong-willed teenager who comes with two younger siblings, Juan and Lita. Rather than separating the children, Pete and Ellie make the life-changing decision to become parents to all three, quickly discovering that building a family is far more complicated than they imagined. Their once peaceful home becomes filled with hilarious misunderstandings, emotional outbursts, unexpected challenges, and moments of overwhelming responsibility. As Pete and Ellie struggle to adjust to parenthood, they must learn how to earn the children’s trust while understanding the difficult experiences that shaped their lives. Lizzy, in particular, finds it hard to accept love and stability after years of disappointment, creating emotional obstacles that test everyone’s patience. With guidance from social workers, support groups, and fellow foster parents, the couple gradually discovers that becoming a family requires much more than good intentions. Through laughter, heartbreak, personal growth, and unforgettable moments of connection, Instant Family delivers a touching story about the realities of foster care and the extraordinary rewards of unconditional love. Combining heartfelt comedy, emotional storytelling, and memorable family moments, the film explores adoption, trust, resilience, belonging, forgiveness, and the true meaning of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 58m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Sean Anders

✍️ Writers: Sean Anders & John Morris

source_details.synopsis: Instant Family is a 2018 American family comedy-drama film starring Mark Wahlberg and Rose Byrne as parents who adopt three siblings, played by Isabela Merced, Gustavo Quiroz, and Julianna Gamiz. It also stars Margo Martindale, Julie Hagerty, Tig Notaro, and Octavia Spencer. The film is directed by Sean Anders, who wrote the screenplay with John Morris, based in part on Anders' own experiences. Instant Family was released in the United States on November 16, 2018. It grossed $121 million worldwide, and was called an "earnest, heartwarming comedy" by critics, who also praised the performances.
